records.name: victory
records.before: if (checkVictory(state)) return { ok: true, state, outcome };

records.name: finished-rejection
records.before: if (state.phase === "finished") return { ok: false, error: "the game is over" };
records.after: if (state.phase === "finished") return { ok: true, state: { ...cloneState(state), phase: "attack" }, outcome: null };
